Two modules for the attachments that arrive with emails.

- `ics-parser.wasm`: calendar invites and feeds (.ics) to events, with organizer, attendees and their responses, times with time zones, all-day events and the invite method (request, cancel, reply)
- `vcard-parser.wasm`: contact cards (.vcf, versions 2.1, 3.0 and 4.0) to contacts, with names, organization, emails, phones and addresses, including the encoded names older phones send

Both pair with `email-parser`. The other modules are unchanged. Every file is built on GitHub from the tagged source, byte-identical to a local `./build.sh`, with `SHA256SUMS` and a signed build attestation.
